title: A prepaid season ticket
hook: Two stated cases: explore the unrecoverable past payment.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the unrecoverable past payment affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the unrecoverable past payment in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy decision has future benefit 20, future cost 5, and an unrecoverable past cost 100. What is the future net benefit?
